subject: Leadership: QBR prep — renewal priority docket & exec attention items
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Leadership: QBR prep — renewal priority docket & exec attention items

Team — attaching the latest renewal risk register ahead of next week's QBR readiness sync. Key ask: please review the top 10 at-risk accounts and flag any updates by EOD tomorrow so I can fold asks into the exec packet. Highlights below and actions I need from each of you. Attachments: renewal_risk_register_v3.xlsx, QBR_stakeholder_matrix.pdf, mutual_action_plan_ACME.docx (stubbed).

Summary (quick scan):
- Acme Corp: health score down 18% MoM after recent latency regressions; procurement seeking clarifications on data residency.
- HorizonHealth: heavy usage spike; operator blips last week but no data loss — renewal conversation scheduled 10/21; procurement starting procurement review.
- BlueRidge: budget-constrained; signal shows churn-risk; customer asked for a usage-based discount.

Immediate asks:
1) Jordan — please validate the service-impact timeline for Acme (latency regression root cause & mitigation ETA).
2) Grace — confirm whether we can offer a 1-yr deferral on premium retention fees as a short-term accommodation for BlueRidge (if we do, include expected margin impact).
3) Rishi — recommend exec-level interventions (credits, contract flexibility, SLA exceptions) and mark which need VP approval.
4) Lauren — I need a one-slide stakeholder map (who to loop on the call for each account).

Intended audience for the packet: CEO/COO, Head of Sales, and 2x AM leads. I will consolidate and send a leadership-ready one-pager by 10/15 5pm PT.

Thanks — Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Attachments: renewal_risk_register_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub, 84KB), QBR_stakeholder_matrix.pdf (pdf stub, 220KB), mutual_action_plan_ACME.docx (doc stub, 40KB)

Date: 2026-10-14T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership: QBR prep — renewal priority docket & exec attention items

Marissa — quick notes after an infra sync this morning:
- Acme: we identified a model-autoscaler interaction with their burst profile; mitigation plan in staging now (config rollback + patched decider). ETA to prod 10/18 EOD; should restore baseline latency but we need to run 72h post-deploy load tests.
- HorizonHealth: the operator blips were tied to a driver regression on our tenant host pool; we rotated to a hot spare; ops recommends a proactive capacity reservation for their account during the monthly ETL window.

Action items I completed: updated the row for Acme in the attached register with the ETA and assigned CI ticket (CI-7721). I think Acme needs an operational SLA exception and a short-term credit (10%) while we finish the 72h validation.

Jordan

Thanks — good starting slate. A few escalation recommendations (per account):
- Acme Corp (High risk): recommend exec call + one-time 12% credit while we prove stability. VP approval required for anything >10%.
- HorizonHealth (Medium risk): offer a temporary capacity reservation + a telemetric SLA for the ETL window; can be signed as an addendum.
- BlueRidge (High risk - budget): propose a usage-led credits pilot for 6 months; require Finance sign-off.

Please add a column in the register for "Exec Ask" and pre-fill with the recommended approval tier (e.g., VP, GM, CFO). I can draft exec email templates for approvals once the register is locked.

Rishi

Marissa — thanks for the transparency and the register. A couple of clarifying points from our side before the 10/21 renewal: 
1) For the latency issue, can Jordan share the proposed validation plan and metrics you plan to run during the 72h window? We want to see P95/P99 across our 1h ETL bursts.
2) On data residency: procurement would like a short write-up on our private deployment options and KMS integration (we raised this in the RFI).

We are available for a 30-minute technical run-through on 10/19 or 10/20. Will that work for your team?

— Sarah

Thanks all — finalizing the leadership packet. Quick readout of exec attention items (pulled into the one-pager):
Top 5 accounts (ask, recommended exec action):
1) Acme Corp — High risk. Ask: exec call + VP approval for one-time 12% credit. Rationale: restore trust during the post-fix validation window; we believe this materially reduces churn probability.
2) BlueRidge — High risk. Ask: finance review for 6-month usage-based credit pilot; AM to own pilot scope.
3) HorizonHealth — Medium risk. Ask: product + ops to approve a capacity reservation addendum for ETL windows; AM to present SLA telemetry.
4) Northport Analytics — Medium risk. Ask: offer a 30-day performance warranty and commit a focused support rotation.
5) Ember Retail — Low/Medium risk. Ask: Customer success to push adoption playbook and a targeted workshop; potential renewal uplift if adoption increases by 20%.

Additional notes:
- I attached the final one-pager as a page in the Drive folder (QBR packet will live in the shared Drive link above).
- Timeline: leadership packet to CEO/COO by 10/16 12pm PT; please flag any disagreement by 10/16 10am PT.

Sarah — 10/19 11am PT works for a technical run-through; Jordan will bring the validation plan and metrics.

Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | Senior Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
